name: s238-climb-005
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; state.body.facing = "front"; state.body.anim = "none"; let L = null; for (let i = 1; i <= 6 && !L; i++) { Object.assign(state.background, { kind: "treeroom", houses: 6, inside: i, figX: 0, figY: 0, things: [] }); changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); measureMarks(); L = marks.ladders.find(q => q.down != null); } state.background.figX = Math.round(L.x); state.background.figY = Math.round(L.z - SCENE.ground); changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); climbLadder(L.el); const t0 = performance.now(); while (performance.now() - t0 < 6000 && !(climb && climb.down && climb.got <= -5 * figureT.k)) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 30)); if (climb) climb.going = true; window.__report = { got: climb && Math.round(climb.got), k: +figureT.k.toFixed(3), clip: !!document.querySelector("#pic g.fig-clip") };
